name: Charlie Cheever
profileSummary: Charlie Cheever is the co-founder of Quora, an online knowledge market. Cheever also founded Expo, a framework which creates apps that works on Android, iOS and web by writing the JavaScript code, and a cloud platform called EAS to accompany it. Additionally, he works at castle.xyz, developing the mobile application Castle - Make and Play which allows users to play and create interactive scenes, which can range from simple art and drawings to tiny homemade games and music.
